caption: The drawing depicts a decorative corner design on a dark, wood-textured background. In the lower right corner, there is a symmetrical floral motif featuring elements in yellow, green, blue, and magenta. The motif includes two yellow flowers, two blue-green flowers, and leafy green stems arranged around a central quadrilateral shape divided into four colored sections: pale blue, yellow, magenta, and dark blue, each containing a central white dot. Surrounding the central motif are more small green leaves and stems. To the upper left, there is an orange-red rectangular section with green leaves, bordered by a thin red outline. Blue dotted circles and white curved lines are also adjacent to this rectangle. The right and lower borders are marked by a repeating pattern of pink and red chevron shapes. The overall composition is framed by a cream-colored edge.
title: Stencilled Floor
